pages.title: At the table, then after play

blocks.text: Follow one declared intent through its result. Reuse the record for a decision that taught you something.
Agree before resolving
Begin with intent. Ordinary actions may need no special purchase. For unusual behavior, inspect owned permissions; agree scope, resolution, stakes and any Cost before rolling.
Who acts, what do they want, and what access applies?
Agreed scope, timing, roll / threshold, success and failure
Agreed use Cost / supplies / duration and continuation point
Resolve and carry the change forward
Use the displayed total once. In combat, coordinate Council and Fast / Measured / Heavy. Movement shares the round's allowance; reactions need their own valid trigger and available slot.
Actual dice + displayed bonus = total; what happened?
Vitality before / after; supplies spent; ongoing effects and their endings
The new situation and the next decision
Keep the useful feedback
Record the rule / page or tool step, what you expected, what happened and any temporary ruling. Leave out other players' private information when sharing feedback.

title: Build with Neris Cinderthread
description: A source-checked construction trail, unique-acquisition ledger and resolved use, with prompts for a personal variation.

blocks.text: Read an existing build as a chain of decisions, then plan a variation of your own.
Checked public level-8 demonstration, 20 October 2026. This is a reading and construction companion, not a new level-1 template or evidence of independent playtesting. Use your GM's starting point.
Begin with the person
A field medic with smoke filtration, trained triage and reusable treatment recipes.

One way to read these choices: trained hands and knowledge support treatment; smoke filtration makes an ordinary smoky route possible; saved recipes keep a bounded use ready. The foundations support the concept without becoming fixed classes.
Read the three foundations

headers: What it contributes to this concept
rows: Fire Resistance and Ordinary Smoke Filtration. Light ordinary smoke is different from heat, toxic gas or magical fumes.
Training, careful handling, carrying support and Splint and Rally. Appropriate supplies and a reachable patient still matter.
Finesse and Knowledge training, useful bonuses, material patching and familiar treatment pieces. Shared acquisitions are counted once.

blocks.text: Existing heritage illustrations: AI-generated with OpenAI tools under Marius Ion's direction. Artwork retains separate notices; companion text CC BY 4.0 does not license these portraits.
Keep access and budgets distinct
Level 8 contributes 99 BU. This saved demo adds 1 DM BU: 100 total. Its 19 unique character acquisitions cost 86 BU, leaving 14. Items cost 14 Item BU separately.

No separate Domain acquisition is stored in this snapshot. Read its bounded authored physical treatments; do not infer unrestricted magical healing. When you fork or build a new character, review the current required access, foundation and budget before applying changes.
Your person: what do they do, and what do they want?
The same acquisition can appear in several compositions without becoming another purchase.

These are new costs in this reading order, not the displayed price of each whole bundle. A later foundation can reference pieces acquired earlier. Count the saved acquisition identity once; a same-name entry alone does not establish that it is the same purchase.
The complete unique character ledger
Character total: 86 BU. Remaining: 100 - 86 = 14 BU. Touch and the stored d4 cost zero here; their presence does not buy extra range or a different behavior.
Items stay on their own ledger
Boundary Marker Satchel: 2 Item BU; Patchplate Vest: 8 Item BU; Patchsmith Roll: 4 Item BU. Total: 14 Item BU. Item-supplied ingredients are not extra character acquisitions.
Which owned acquisition would your next idea reuse? What genuinely new access would it need?
A bounded worked use, followed by room to plan your own variation.
Read the saved recipe before rolling

Gentle Treatment uses Patient Reassurance Influence +2 and Mended Vitality, whose stored output is Minor Die Block (1d4). The reassurance applies only with a willing patient during the named treatment; end that condition when treatment ends or consent is withdrawn.
Neris also owns a d8. It does not silently replace the saved 1d4 recipe. Changing a recipe requires reviewing its access, scope and Cost; owning an ingredient is different from resolving a use.
One illustrative table agreement

A willing, reachable patient has 6 of 12 Vitality, with time outside immediate danger. A suitable clean dressing is available. The table agrees a bounded treatment, an Influence check against DC 12, 1d4 recovery on success, and one dressing spent. No extra Vitality Cost is chosen for this attempt; these are scene agreements, not universal treatment rules.

rows: d20 shows 7; 7 + 10 = 17, meeting DC 12. Do not add PB again.
The authored 1d4 shows 3. The patient moves from 6/12 to 9/12 Vitality.
Dressing: 1 to 0. Neris stays at 104/104 Vitality. End the treatment-only reassurance condition.

blocks.text: Roll and apply the agreed changes manually. Saving or triggering the capability does not automatically heal a different sheet. Record the supply spent and the new situation; further treatment needs its own fiction and agreement.
